title: EVAC LAYER site (data/sites/<id>.json)
description: One installed screen. Its coordinates and facing decide the shelter, direction and distance on every screen made for it. The file name is <id>.json. Several sites may share a municipality.

municipality_id.description: JIS municipality code of the place the screen stands in. `pnpm -F agents site` fills it from lat/lng with the GSI reverse geocoder.

facing_deg.description: Compass bearing the viewer faces while reading the screen (0 = north). The arrow to the shelter is turned against it. Leave it out when the facing is not known: the screens then show a north-fixed compass arrow (north up, marked N / 北) with the direction word beside it.

location_updated_at.description: When lat, lng or facing_deg (including gaining or losing it) last changed through the admin API. Screens composed before it were made for the old place.

facility_id.description: The facility the site belongs to. A facility credential (data/tokens.json) acts only on sites with its facility_id; a site without one is reached by the operator credential only.

replay.description: Demo only: the site replays a recorded feed instead of following data/live/<id>.json.

municipality.description: Recording to replay when it is not the site's own municipality.
